rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: itnet_k=1, unet_c=32, itnet_alpha_init=0.0004, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=0.00025, pretrain_epochs=15, pretrain_patience=15, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=2400, val_n=200, seed=42, rationale=ITER-14 (v3 sentinel, normal QOS, strict serial). SIX-BOX (sentinel-verified): iter-6 c32/n2400/alpha0.0026 0.8768; iter-13 c32/n2400/alpha0.001 0.8804=BEST (smaller DC-step alpha HELPED +0.0036 -- the k=1 DC step was slightly over-strong; a milder step lets the strong pretrained denoiser recon dominate, consistent with k>=2 collapse). (2) OPEN QUESTION: is alpha monotonic-better as it shrinks toward 0 (pure denoiser)? iter-13 (0.001) beat iter-6 (0.0026); test even smaller. (3) ONE KNOB vs iter-13 (c32/n2400/alpha0.001): itnet_alpha_init 0.001 -> 0.0004. Hold c=32, n=2400, k=1, lr=2.5e-4, ep=15, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if alpha 0.001->0.0004, hr rises above 0.8804 because an even milder DC step corrupts the denoiser recon even less (approaching pure-denoiser). FALSIFIER: hr <= ~0.880 => alpha optimum is near 0.001 (or the DC step's tiny residual consistency has some value); then iter-15 locks alpha=0.001 champion and does seed replicates. (5) BUDGET: identical to iter-6 (c32/n2400) -- only alpha changes. (6) STRICT one-at-a-time; rm DONE.* before dispatch; confirm via ssh cat DONE.<jobid>.
